entries.en: My parents chose not to anglify the spelling of our family name.
entries.zh: 我的父母选择不把我们家姓氏的拼写英语化。

entries.en: The visiting Anglist noticed a literary reference that the rest of the seminar had missed.
entries.zh: 那位来访的英学专家注意到了一处其他研讨课参加者没有看出的文学典故。

entries.en: She studied Anglistics before turning her attention to the history of translation.
entries.zh: 她先学习了英语学，后来把注意力转向翻译史。

entries.en: Our Anglo-Arabian waited quietly while the farrier examined its damaged shoe.
entries.zh: 蹄铁匠检查那匹马受损的蹄铁时，我们的盎格鲁阿拉伯马安静地等着。

entries.meaningZh: 英国国教高教会派教徒
entries.en: An Anglo-Catholic offered to show us the collection of old prayer books after the service.
entries.zh: 礼拜结束后，一位英国国教高教会派教徒主动提出带我们看那批旧祈祷书。

entries.en: The youngest Anglo-Nubian squeezed through the fence and started eating the gardener's flowers.
entries.zh: 年纪最小的那只英努山羊从篱笆中挤了过去，开始吃园丁的花。

entries.meaningZh: 盎格鲁撒克逊族的领土〔历史用语〕
entries.en: The medieval map placed the monastery near the edge of Anglo-Saxondom.
entries.zh: 那幅中世纪地图把这座修道院标在盎格鲁撒克逊族领土的边缘附近。

entries.en: The syllabus felt Anglocentric because almost every reading concerned England.
entries.zh: 这份教学大纲让人觉得以英格兰为中心，因为几乎每篇阅读材料都涉及英格兰。

entries.en: The editor challenged the book's Anglocentrism and asked for more attention to other countries.
entries.zh: 编辑质疑这本书的盎格鲁中心主义，并要求更多地关注其他国家。

entries.en: The novel's Anglomaniac fills every room with souvenirs from visits to England.
entries.zh: 小说中那位醉心英国的人，把到访英格兰时带回的纪念品摆满了每个房间。

entries.en: Her brother's Anglomaniacal tastes extended from country houses to the smallest details of afternoon tea.
entries.zh: 她那位兄弟醉心英国的喜好，大到乡间大宅，小到下午茶最细小的讲究。

entries.en: His Anglophiliac enthusiasm led him to collect old English railway posters.
entries.zh: 他因醉心英国而热衷于收集旧英国铁路海报。

entries.en: The story's Anglophobe refuses to enter the English bookshop, even when it begins to rain.
entries.zh: 故事里那位仇英者甚至在开始下雨时，也不肯走进那家英国书店。

entries.en: The analyst compared the angolamycin peak with a reference trace recorded on the same day.
entries.zh: 分析人员把安哥拉霉素峰与同一天记录的对照谱线作了比较。

entries.en: An extra peak prevented a confident identification of angolensin in the plant extract.
entries.zh: 植物提取物中多出的一个峰，使人无法有把握地鉴定出安哥拉紫檀素。

entries.en: The old analysis distinguished angosturine from the other substances recovered from the bark.
entries.zh: 那次旧分析把安果斯都拉树皮碱与从树皮中分离出的其他物质区分开来。

entries.en: The old map of Angoumois was folded inside a travel diary with several missing pages.
entries.zh: 那幅昂古穆瓦旧地图折好后夹在一本缺了几页的旅行日记里。

entries.en: The gardener moved the Angraecum collection away from the broken greenhouse window.
entries.zh: 园丁把那批彗星兰属植物移到了远离温室破窗的地方。

entries.en: The curator compared the Anguidae specimens with the photographs used in the older reptile catalogue.
entries.zh: 策展人把蛇蜥科标本与旧版爬行动物目录采用的照片作了比较。

entries.en: The report on anguidin was returned because it did not identify the reference material clearly.
entries.zh: 那份蛇形菌素报告被退回了，因为它没有清楚说明所用的对照物质。

entries.en: The survey of the island's anguifauna combined field observations with records from the local museum.
entries.zh: 那项海岛蛇区系调查结合了野外观察与当地博物馆的记录。

entries.en: Several Anguillidae specimens remained unidentified to species when the survey ended.
entries.zh: 调查结束时，还有几份鳗鲡科标本没有鉴定到种。

entries.en: The fish atlas devoted a separate section to Anguilliformes, with drawings beside the specimen photographs.
entries.zh: 那本鱼类图谱为鳗形目单设了一节，把图画放在标本照片旁。

entries.en: The older chart arranged Anguilloidei differently from the classification used in the new display.
entries.zh: 那幅较旧的图表对鳗亚目的排列方式，与新展览采用的分类不同。

entries.meaningZh: 鳗形线虫属〔历史分类名〕
entries.en: The zoologist compared the old Anguillula drawings with specimens preserved in the collection.
entries.zh: 动物学家把旧的鳗形线虫属图画与藏品中保存的标本作了比较。

entries.en: The historical account of anguilluliasis included examination findings but no record of the patient's earlier health.
entries.zh: 那份鳗形线虫病历史记述包含检查结果，却没有记录患者此前的健康情况。

entries.en: The physician's notes on anguillulosis were kept with the original parasite drawings.
entries.zh: 医生关于鳗形线虫病的笔记，与原来的寄生虫图画一起保存。

entries.en: The drawing showed a small fracture near the angulus of the mandible.
entries.zh: 那幅图画出了一处靠近下颌骨角的细小骨折。

entries.en: The reviewer asked whether the experiments used angustmycin A or angustmycin C, since the report never specified which.
entries.zh: 审稿人询问实验用的是狭霉素A还是狭霉素C，因为报告始终没有说明是哪一种。

entries.meaningZh: 安古斯图腊树皮〔旧药材名〕
entries.en: The museum displayed dried angustura beside the pharmacy's original purchase records.
entries.zh: 博物馆把干燥的安古斯图腊树皮与药房原来的采购记录一起展出。

entries.en: She compared the published anhalamine spectrum with a reference plot whose peak labels were complete.
entries.zh: 她把已发表的老头掌胺谱图与一张峰标注完整的对照图作了比较。

entries.en: The anhaline measurements could not be combined because the two records used different units.
entries.zh: 两份记录采用了不同单位，因此安哈林的测量数据无法合并。

entries.en: The revised analysis distinguished anhalonidine from another compound whose signal had overlapped it in the earlier spectrum.
entries.zh: 修订后的分析把安哈罗尼定与另一种化合物区分开来；在较早的谱图中，两者的信号曾经重叠。

entries.en: The old laboratory notebook listed anhalonine separately from the plant material brought in for comparison.
entries.zh: 那本旧实验笔记把老头掌碱与送来作比较的植物材料分开列出。

entries.en: The botanical historian compared the Anhalonium illustrations with the specimens described in the old catalogue.
entries.zh: 植物学史研究者把老头掌属插图与旧目录中描述的标本作了比较。

entries.en: The faded map of Anhalt still showed a railway line missing from the later edition.
entries.zh: 那幅褪色的安哈尔特地图上，仍画着一条较晚版本中没有的铁路线。

entries.en: The old examination recorded anhaphia in the fingers but gave no findings for the palm.
entries.zh: 那次旧检查记录了手指触觉缺失，却没有提供手掌的检查结果。

entries.en: The patient's anhelation made it difficult to finish a sentence without pausing.
entries.zh: 患者因气促，难以不作停顿就说完一句话。

entries.en: The anhelous patient paused several times while describing the previous night's events.
entries.zh: 那位气促的患者在描述前一晚发生的事时，停顿了好几次。

entries.en: The historical discussion of anhematopoiesis distinguished deficient blood formation from loss through bleeding.
entries.zh: 那篇关于血液生成不足的历史论述，把造血不足与出血造成的丢失区分开来。

entries.meaningZh: 无血生成的〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The physician questioned the claimed anhematopoietic state because the records contained no evidence about blood formation.
entries.zh: 医生质疑所声称的无血生成状态，因为那些记录没有提供关于造血的证据。

entries.en: The account of anhematosis gave blood counts but did not explain how production had been assessed.
entries.zh: 那份血液生成不足记述提供了血细胞计数，却没有解释如何评估血液生成。

entries.en: The paper compared the anhemolytic strains with strains that damaged the red blood cells.
entries.zh: 论文把不溶血菌株与会损伤红细胞的菌株作了比较。

entries.en: The historical report of anhepatia separated the examination findings from the author's explanation of their cause.
entries.zh: 那份肝机能缺失历史报告，把检查结果与作者对其原因的解释分开记录。

entries.en: The old discussion considered anhepatic jaundice without establishing the cause of the patient's condition.
entries.zh: 那篇旧论述考虑了非肝性黄疸，却没有确定患者病情的原因。

entries.en: The researcher considered an anhepatogenic origin but had not yet established where the substance was produced.
entries.zh: 研究人员考虑了非肝原性来源，却尚未确定该物质在何处生成。

entries.en: The review questioned the claimed anhidrotic effect because the comparison included no measurements of sweating.
entries.zh: 那篇综述质疑所宣称的止汗效果，因为比较研究中没有测量出汗情况。

entries.en: The ornithologist placed the Anhimidae photographs beside the older drawings for comparison.
entries.zh: 鸟类学家把叫鸭科照片放在较旧的图画旁作比较。

entries.en: The museum moved its Anhingidae specimens to a new cabinet during the renovation.
entries.zh: 翻修期间，博物馆把蛇鹈科标本移进了一个新柜子。

entries.meaningZh: 无构造的〔组织学旧用语〕
entries.en: The apparently anhistic layer was easier to distinguish in the enlarged tissue drawing.
entries.zh: 在放大的组织图中，那层看似无构造的组织更容易辨认。

entries.meaningZh: 无构造的〔组织学旧用语〕
entries.en: The old illustration contrasts an anhistous region with the clearly organised tissue beside it.
entries.zh: 那幅旧插图把无构造区域与旁边结构清楚的组织作了对比。

entries.meaningZh: 无构造动物；原生动物〔旧分类用语〕
entries.en: The lecture compared the old grouping anhistozoa with the categories used in a later zoological chart.
entries.zh: 讲座比较了旧的无构造动物类划分与较晚动物学图表采用的分类。

entries.en: We spent a rainy afternoon in Anhui sorting photographs from the previous week's journey.
entries.zh: 我们在安徽一个下雨的下午，整理了前一周旅行的照片。

entries.en: The old travel account of Anhwei contained sketches of bridges but no names for the villages.
entries.zh: 那份有关安徽的旧游记中有桥梁素描，却没有写出村庄的名称。

entries.en: The study compared anhydrase activity in the extracts without assuming that protein content alone explained the differences.
entries.zh: 那项研究比较了提取液中的脱水酶活性，没有假定仅凭蛋白含量就能解释差异。

entries.en: The researcher separated the measurements taken before anhydration from those recorded after water had been removed.
entries.zh: 研究人员把脱水前的测量数据与去水后的记录分开保存。

entries.en: The miner pointed out a pale band of anhydrite between two darker layers of rock.
entries.zh: 矿工指出了两层较暗岩石之间的一条浅色硬石膏带。

entries.en: The historical report described an anhydrochloric secretion but gave no details of the acid measurements.
entries.zh: 那份历史报告描述了一种无盐酸的分泌液，却没有说明酸测量的细节。

entries.en: The analyst found that the peak assigned to anhydroecgonine also contained an unresolved signal from another substance.
entries.zh: 分析人员发现，被归属于脱水芽子碱的那个峰还包含另一种物质未分离开的信号。

entries.en: The chemist examined the anhydroenneaheptitol spectrum again because the proposed structure left two signals unexplained.
entries.zh: 化学家再次检查了脱水壬七醇的谱图，因为所提出的结构仍无法解释两个信号。

entries.en: The report distinguished anhydroglucochloral from the other substances in the sample without establishing how it had arrived there.
entries.zh: 报告把脱水葡萄糖缩氯醛与样品中的其他物质区分开来，却没有确定它如何进入样品。

entries.en: The analyst compared the anhydroglucose result with the original spectrum before revising the table.
entries.zh: 分析人员修改表格前，把葡糖酐的检测结果与原始谱图作了比较。

entries.en: The chemist wanted to identify the anhydrohexitol before accepting the proposed arrangement of its atoms.
entries.zh: 化学家想先鉴定那种失水己糖醇，再接受所提出的原子排列方式。

entries.en: The historical analysis of anhydrohydroxyprogesterone was difficult to assess because the original spectrum had been lost.
entries.zh: 那份有关脱水羟基孕酮的历史分析难以评估，因为原始谱图已经遗失。

entries.en: The researcher checked the reference spectrum before accepting the reported identification of anhydroleucovorin.
entries.zh: 研究人员核对了对照谱图，才接受报告中对次甲基四氢叶酸的鉴定结果。

entries.meaningZh: 脊髓液缺乏〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The old account of anhydromyelia did not say how the amount of spinal fluid had been assessed.
entries.zh: 那份脊髓液缺乏的旧记述，没有说明如何评估脊髓液的量。

entries.en: The laboratory's purchase record listed anhydrone separately from the replacement glassware.
entries.zh: 实验室采购记录把无水高氯酸镁与补购的玻璃器皿分开列出。

entries.en: The study distinguished an anhydrosugar from the unchanged sugar present in the same sample.
entries.zh: 那项研究把一种脱水糖与同份样品中存在的未变化糖区分开来。

entries.en: The historical notes on anhypnia described nights spent awake but gave little detail about daytime rest.
entries.zh: 那份有关失眠症的历史笔记描述了夜间不眠的情况，却很少记载白天休息的情况。

entries.en: The engineer compared the damaged Anhyster component with the original drawing before ordering a replacement.
entries.zh: 工程师把受损的安西斯特铁镍合金部件与原图作了比较，才订购替换件。

entries.en: The anatomical drawing of anhysteria was kept with the original examination notes.
entries.zh: 那幅无子宫畸形解剖图，与原始检查笔记一起保存。

entries.en: The old report on aniacinamidosis gave a detailed diet history without establishing the amount of nicotinamide consumed.
entries.zh: 那份烟酰胺缺乏病旧报告详细记载了饮食史，却没有确定烟酰胺的摄入量。

entries.en: The account of aniacinosis distinguished the reported meals from the author's estimates of niacin intake.
entries.zh: 那份烟酸缺乏病记述，把所报告的餐食与作者估算的烟酸摄入量区分开来。

entries.en: The old assessment of anianthinopsy recorded difficulty distinguishing the purple samples from the comparison colours.
entries.zh: 那份紫色盲旧评估记录了难以把紫色样本与对照颜色区分开来的情况。

entries.meaningZh: 无体形畸胎的〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The anidean specimen appeared only as a roughly outlined mass in the historical anatomical plate.
entries.zh: 在那幅历史解剖图版中，无体形畸胎标本只被画成一团轮廓粗略的组织。

entries.meaningZh: 无体形畸胎〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The curator compared two historical drawings of an anideus without accepting every anatomical detail they suggested.
entries.zh: 策展人比较了两幅无体形畸胎的历史图画，没有接受图中暗示的每一处解剖细节。

entries.meaningZh: 无体形的〔旧胚胎学用语〕
entries.en: The old description called the fetal mass anidous, but its accompanying illustration was incomplete.
entries.zh: 旧记述把那团胚胎组织描述为无体形的，可配图并不完整。

entries.en: The examination recorded anidrosis in the affected region rather than assuming that sweating had stopped everywhere.
entries.zh: 检查记录了患处的无汗症，没有直接认定全身都停止了出汗。

entries.en: The museum's model of Anik hung above a display of early satellite television equipment.
entries.zh: 博物馆的“兄弟”号卫星模型，悬挂在一组早期卫星电视设备展品上方。

entries.en: The pharmacy's old inventory listed anileridine separately from the empty containers awaiting disposal.
entries.zh: 药房的旧库存清单，把阿尼利定与等待处理的空容器分开列出。

entries.en: The chemist compared the anilid with the starting material rather than assuming that the reaction was complete.
entries.zh: 化学家把那种酰基苯胺与起始材料作了比较，没有直接假定反应已经完成。

entries.en: The proposed anilide structure did not explain every signal in the recorded spectrum.
entries.zh: 所提出的N-酰苯胺结构，不能解释所记录谱图中的每一个信号。

entries.en: The old dye-factory ledger recorded anilin purchases beside the orders for new storage tanks.
entries.zh: 那本旧染料厂账簿，把苯胺采购记录与新储罐订单记在一起。

entries.en: An extra signal in the anilinephthalein spectrum prompted the analyst to question the sample's purity.
entries.zh: 苯胺酞谱图中多出的一个信号，使分析人员开始怀疑样品的纯度。

entries.en: The historical study of anilinism compared factory workers' accounts with the surviving workplace records.
entries.zh: 那项苯胺中毒历史研究，把工人的叙述与留存的工作场所记录作了比较。

entries.en: The anilinophilous structures stood out more clearly in the second tissue image.
entries.zh: 那些嗜苯胺结构在第二张组织图像中更加醒目。

entries.en: The old order for anilinum was filed with the dye workshop's other chemical purchases.
entries.zh: 那张苯胺旧订单，与染料车间的其他化学品采购单归在一起。

entries.en: The museum displayed an unopened packet of anilipyrine beside the pharmacy's original stock list.
entries.zh: 博物馆把一包未开封的阿尼利匹林与药房原来的库存清单一起展出。

entries.en: The account of anilism included workers' symptoms but no measurements of exposure in the factory.
entries.zh: 那份苯胺中毒记述包含工人的症状，却没有提供工厂中接触量的测量数据。

entries.en: Missing transport records made it difficult for the historian to trace the wartime shipment of anilite.
entries.zh: 运输记录的缺失，使历史学家难以追查那批战时安尼炸药的运输经过。

entries.meaningZh: 老妪般的衰弱〔旧式贬称〕
entries.en: The novel's narrator mistakes the elderly woman's patience for anility, then discovers how carefully she has planned her escape.
entries.zh: 小说的叙述者把那位年老妇人的耐心误当成老妪般的衰弱，后来才发现她为逃走做了多么周密的计划。

entries.meaningZh: 酒精苯胺混合物〔旧燃料组分名〕
entries.en: The historian compared the early claims about anilol with the engine-test records preserved in the company's archive.
entries.zh: 历史学家把早期有关酒精苯胺混合物的说法，与公司档案中保存的发动机试验记录作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 精原论者〔旧胚胎学说的支持者〕
entries.en: The historian contrasted the animalculist's account of embryonic development with the competing view that gave priority to the egg.
entries.zh: 历史学家把那位精原论者对胚胎发育的解释，与另一种把卵置于首位的观点作了比较。

entries.en: The student placed the specimen within Animalia but could not determine its narrower classification.
entries.zh: 学生把那份标本归入动物界，却无法确定它更细的分类。

entries.meaningZh: 安尼米基系〔旧地层名称〕
entries.en: The faded geological map assigned the lower rock layers to the Animikean, but its accompanying notes were missing.
entries.zh: 那幅褪色的地质图把下部岩层划归安尼米基系，可随附的说明笔记已经遗失。

entries.meaningZh: 内分泌缺乏病〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The historical account of anincretinasis did not identify which gland's secretions were deficient.
entries.zh: 那份内分泌缺乏病历史记述，没有说明缺乏的是哪个腺体的分泌物。

entries.meaningZh: 内分泌缺乏病〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The physician distinguished the discussion of anincretinosis from the patient's separately recorded nutritional problems.
entries.zh: 医生把内分泌缺乏病的讨论，与另行记录的患者营养问题区分开来。

entries.meaningZh: 反胰岛激素〔旧生理学用语〕
entries.en: The historical paper attributed the rise in blood sugar to aninsulin but provided no direct measurement of the proposed hormone.
entries.zh: 那篇历史论文把血糖升高归因于反胰岛激素，却没有提供这种假定激素的直接测量数据。

entries.en: The technician inspected the anionite column after the outlet water failed the routine test.
entries.zh: 出水未通过例行检测后，技术人员检查了阴离子交换剂柱。

entries.en: The diagram contrasted the anionoid group with the positively charged region of the molecule.
entries.zh: 那幅图把类阴离子基团与分子中带正电的区域作了对比。

entries.en: The eye specialist compared photographs of her aniridia taken several years apart.
entries.zh: 眼科专科医生比较了相隔数年拍摄、显示她无虹膜情况的照片。

entries.en: The old record of aniridism included drawings of both eyes, not just the more clearly affected one.
entries.zh: 那份无虹膜旧记录中有双眼的图画，而不只是受影响更明显的那只眼。

entries.en: The proposed structure placed an anisal group at the opposite end of the molecule from the amino group.
entries.zh: 所提出的结构把甲氧苯亚甲基放在分子中与氨基相对的另一端。

entries.en: The analyst kept the anisalcohol measurements separate from those for the corresponding aldehyde.
entries.zh: 分析人员把茴香醇的测量数据，与相应醛的测量数据分开保存。

entries.meaningZh: 茴香醛；对甲氧基苯甲醛
entries.en: The chemist compared the anisaldehyde spectrum with that of the alcohol rather than relying on the sample's smell.
entries.zh: 化学家把茴香醛谱图与醇的谱图作比较，没有仅凭样品气味作判断。

entries.en: The proposed anisaldoxime structure required closer comparison with the spectrum of the starting aldehyde.
entries.zh: 所提出的茴香肟结构，需要与起始醛的谱图作更仔细的比较。

entries.en: The analyst checked which metal was present in the anisate before interpreting its composition.
entries.zh: 分析人员解释那种茴香酸盐的组成前，先核查其中含有哪种金属。

entries.en: The baker kept the anisated biscuits on a separate tray from the plain ones.
entries.zh: 面包师把含茴香的饼干与原味饼干放在不同托盘上。

entries.en: The old notes on anischuria recorded when the episodes occurred without assuming that they happened every night.
entries.zh: 那份遗尿旧笔记记下了发作时间，没有直接认定每晚都会发生。

entries.en: The perfumer compared the anisic notes with the sharper scent of the other sample.
entries.zh: 调香师把洋茴香香调与另一份样品较为刺鼻的气味作了比较。

entries.en: The report on anisidine was incomplete because it did not state which isomer had been examined.
entries.zh: 那份茴香胺报告并不完整，因为它没有说明检查的是哪种异构体。

entries.en: The archive contained an order for anisindione but no record confirming that the shipment had arrived.
entries.zh: 档案中有一张茴茚二酮订单，却没有记录证实那批货已经送达。

entries.en: The historical analysis treated anisine as a separate alkaloid but did not establish its proposed structure.
entries.zh: 那次历史分析把洋茴香碱视为一种独立的生物碱，却没有证实所提出的结构。

entries.en: The report noted anisochromia, with some red cells staining more deeply than others.
entries.zh: 报告记载了色素不均，一些红细胞的染色比另一些更深。

entries.en: The examination recorded anisocoria but did not establish why the two pupils differed in size.
entries.zh: 检查记录了瞳孔不等，却没有确定双侧瞳孔大小不同的原因。

entries.en: The old eye chart recorded anisocycloplegia separately from the measurements of pupil size.
entries.zh: 那张旧眼科检查表，把睫状肌麻痹不均与瞳孔大小的测量分开记录。

entries.en: The enlarged blood image showed anisocytosis more clearly than the smaller print beside it.
entries.zh: 那张放大的血液图像，比旁边的小幅印图更清楚地显示了红细胞大小不均。

entries.en: The illustrator redrew the anisodactylous foot so that the differences between the toes were visible.
entries.zh: 插画师重新画了那只足趾长短不等的脚，使趾间差异清楚可见。

entries.en: The laboratory rejected the anisodamine result because the reference sample had not been identified reliably.
entries.zh: 实验室没有接受山莨菪碱的检测结果，因为对照样品未得到可靠鉴定。

entries.en: The anisodont jaw was shown from the side to make the unequal tooth lengths easier to compare.
entries.zh: 那副牙长短不齐的颌骨以侧面展示，使不等的牙齿长度更容易比较。

entries.en: The student compared front and side views of the anisognathous specimen before completing the drawing.
entries.zh: 学生完成画稿前，比较了那份上下颌不等标本的正面与侧面图。

entries.en: The palaeontologist compared the Anisograptidae fossils with the drawings in an older collection catalogue.
entries.zh: 古生物学家把反称笔石科化石与较旧藏品目录中的图画作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 比率异常性白细胞增多〔旧血液学用语〕
entries.en: The account of anisohypercytosis recorded both a raised white-cell count and a changed neutrophil proportion.
entries.zh: 那份比率异常性白细胞增多记述，同时记录了白细胞总数增加与中性白细胞比例变化。

entries.meaningZh: 比率异常性白细胞减少〔旧血液学用语〕
entries.en: The old report of anisohypocytosis compared the total white-cell count with the proportions of the different cell types.
entries.zh: 那份比率异常性白细胞减少旧报告，把白细胞总数与各类细胞的比例作了比较。

entries.en: The writer described an anisoic aroma but gave no details about the plant material in the jar.
entries.zh: 作者描述了一种洋茴香香气，却没有说明罐中植物材料的细节。

entries.en: The account of anisoiconia compared the image seen by each eye rather than assuming that the two were equal.
entries.zh: 那份物象不等记述，比较了两眼各自看到的影像，没有直接假定二者相同。

entries.en: The chemist asked for a clearer anisoin spectrum before accepting the proposed arrangement of the functional groups.
entries.zh: 在接受所提出的官能团排列之前，化学家要求提供更清楚的茴香偶姻谱图。

entries.en: The old laboratory ledger recorded anisol separately from the phenol used in another investigation.
entries.zh: 那本旧实验室账簿，把苯甲醚与另一项研究所用的苯酚分开记录。

entries.en: The analyst compared the anisole peak with a reference recorded before the instrument was repaired.
entries.zh: 分析人员把茴香醚峰与仪器修理前记录的对照谱线作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 白细胞比率不定〔旧血液学用语〕
entries.en: The discussion of anisoleukocytosis considered the cell proportions separately from the total white-cell count.
entries.zh: 关于白细胞比率不定的讨论，将细胞比例与白细胞总数分开考虑。

entries.en: The historical account of anisomastia distinguished size differences from the patient's separately reported pain.
entries.zh: 那份乳房大小不等的历史记述，把大小差异与患者另行报告的疼痛区分开来。

entries.en: The table showed different molecular formulas for the two anisomeric compounds.
entries.zh: 表格列出了那两种非同质异构化合物不同的分子式。

entries.en: The student counted the floral organs again before completing the diagram of the anisomerous flower.
entries.zh: 学生完成那朵不对称花的图解前，又数了一遍各类花器官。

entries.meaningZh: 白细胞比率不定〔旧血液学用语〕
entries.en: The old report recorded anisonormocytosis even though the total white-cell count remained within the stated range.
entries.zh: 那份旧报告记录了白细胞比率不定，尽管白细胞总数仍处在所列范围内。

entries.en: The artist drew both leaves of the anisophyllous pair instead of giving them equal outlines.
entries.zh: 画家画出了那对不等叶的两片叶子，而没有把它们画成大小相同的轮廓。

entries.en: The field guide placed the Anisoptera photographs beside drawings of the collected specimens.
entries.zh: 那本野外指南把蜻蜓类照片放在所采集标本的图画旁。

entries.meaningZh: 有性孢子〔旧生物学用语〕
entries.en: The old diagram placed an anisospore beside the smaller cell with which it would unite.
entries.zh: 那幅旧图把一个有性孢子画在将与它结合的较小细胞旁。

entries.en: The botanical artist drew the anisostemonous flower with the differently shaped stamens clearly separated.
entries.zh: 植物画师画出了那朵雄蕊异形的花，把形状不同的雄蕊清楚地分开呈现。

entries.en: The old assessment compared the anisosthenic muscle groups rather than judging both sides from one measurement.
entries.zh: 那次旧评估比较了力量不等的肌群，没有只用一次测量来判断两侧情况。

entries.en: The comparison used anisotonic solutions, but the report did not state their measured osmotic pressures.
entries.zh: 那次比较采用了不等渗溶液，但报告没有提供测得的渗透压。

entries.en: The survey included several Anisotremus specimens without identifying every fish to species level.
entries.zh: 那次调查纳入了几份异孔石鲈属标本，但没有把每条鱼都鉴定到种。

entries.en: The engineer tested the anisotropal material both along the fibres and across them.
entries.zh: 工程师沿纤维方向和横跨纤维的方向，分别测试了那种各向异性材料。

entries.en: During the investigation of anisotropisation, measurements along the fibres began to differ from those taken across them.
entries.zh: 研究各向异性化作用时，沿纤维方向的测量结果开始与横跨纤维方向的结果出现差异。

entries.en: The board's anisotropism became apparent when the bending tests were repeated in the other direction.
entries.zh: 换一个方向重复弯曲测试后，那块板的各向异性显现出来。

entries.en: The old chart recorded anisuria by listing different urine volumes for successive hours.
entries.zh: 那张旧图表列出连续各小时不同的尿量，以记录尿量不等的情况。

entries.en: The analyst kept the anisylacetone measurements separate because the second record used a different scale.
entries.zh: 由于第二份记录采用了不同标度，分析人员把茴香酮的测量数据分开保存。

entries.en: Anit left a note beside the unfinished drawing before going out to buy more paper.
entries.zh: 阿尼特出门买更多纸之前，在尚未画完的画旁留了一张便条。

entries.en: The table lists the anitrogenous components separately from the nitrogen-containing compounds.
entries.zh: 表格把非氮性成分与含氮化合物分开列出。

entries.en: Ankeny returned the borrowed bicycle with a new light attached to the handlebars.
entries.zh: 安克尼归还了借来的自行车，车把上装着一盏新灯。

entries.en: The geologist photographed the ankerite beside the fractured edge of the surrounding rock.
entries.zh: 地质学家拍下了围岩断裂边缘旁的铁白云石。

entries.en: The old diary of Anking contained a sketch of the river but no date for the drawing.
entries.zh: 那本安庆旧日记里有一幅河流素描，却没有标注绘制日期。

entries.en: The zoologist compared the old Ankistrodon drawings without assuming that every specimen belonged to the same species.
entries.zh: 动物学家比较了旧的蝮属图画，没有直接认定每份标本都属于同一种。

entries.en: The anatomical drawing showed a small fracture near the back of the ankle-bone.
entries.zh: 那幅解剖图画出了一处靠近距骨后部的细小骨折。

entries.en: She could move her ankle-joint, but the swelling made her usual shoes uncomfortable.
entries.zh: 她能活动踝关节，但肿胀让平时穿的鞋变得不舒服。

entries.en: The surgeon's drawing showed an ankyla between two tissue surfaces, away from the joint.
entries.zh: 外科医生的图画出了一处远离关节、连接两个组织表面的粘连。

entries.en: The anatomical plate showed ankylenteron joining two intestinal loops that the earlier sketch had drawn separately.
entries.zh: 那幅解剖图版显示，肠粘连把先前素描中分开画出的两个肠袢连在了一起。

entries.meaningZh: 尿道粘连性狭窄〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The historical account of ankylo-urethria included a drawing of the narrowed region but no measurements of its length.
entries.zh: 那份尿道粘连性狭窄的历史记述中有狭窄处的图画，却没有其长度测量数据。

entries.en: The eye specialist compared the ankyloblepharon drawings with photographs taken during the examination.
entries.zh: 眼科专科医生把睑缘粘连图画与检查时拍摄的照片作了比较。

entries.en: The old anatomical drawing showed ankylochilia more clearly than the brief description beside it.
entries.zh: 那幅旧解剖图比旁边的简短描述更清楚地展示了唇粘连。

entries.meaningZh: 关节强硬恐怖〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: In the old interview, her ankylophobia surfaced whenever the conversation turned to joints becoming permanently stiff.
entries.zh: 在那次旧访谈中，每当谈到关节永久变得僵硬时，她对关节强硬的恐惧便显露出来。

entries.en: The old record of ankyloproctia included examination findings without establishing how the narrowing had developed.
entries.zh: 那份肛门狭窄旧记录包含检查结果，却没有确定狭窄是如何形成的。

entries.en: The enlarged drawing showed ankylorrhinia between surfaces that appeared separate in the earlier sketch.
entries.zh: 放大的图画显示，先前素描中看似分开的表面之间存在鼻粘连。

entries.en: The museum arranged the Ankylosauria drawings beside photographs of the fossil material.
entries.zh: 博物馆把甲龙亚目图画与化石材料的照片排放在一起。

entries.en: The old parasite atlas devoted a separate plate to Ankylostoma and the specimens used for comparison.
entries.zh: 那本旧寄生虫图谱用单独一幅图版展示钩口线虫属及用于比较的标本。

entries.en: The historical account of ankylostomiasis compared the examination findings with the patient's earlier health records.
entries.zh: 那份钩虫病历史记述，把检查结果与患者此前的健康记录作了比较。

entries.en: The curator kept the Ankylostomum illustrations with the original specimen records for historical comparison.
entries.zh: 策展人把钩口线虫属插图与原始标本记录一起保存，供历史比较。

entries.en: The anatomical drawing of ankylotia was enlarged because the closed canal's boundary was unclear in the original print.
entries.zh: 由于原印图中闭锁耳道的边界不清楚，那幅外耳道闭锁解剖图被放大了。

entries.en: The museum displayed an ankylotome separately from the dental instruments in the neighbouring case.
entries.zh: 博物馆把一把舌系带刀与旁边展柜中的牙科器械分开展示。

entries.meaningZh: 尿道粘连性狭窄〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The report on ankylurethria needed a clearer drawing before the two descriptions of the narrowing could be compared.
entries.zh: 那份尿道粘连性狭窄报告需要更清楚的图画，之后才能比较对狭窄处的两种描述。

entries.en: The diagram placed ankyrin between the membrane proteins and the supporting network beneath them.
entries.zh: 那幅图把锚蛋白画在膜蛋白与其下方的支撑网络之间。

entries.en: The illustrator enlarged the ankyroid projection so that its curved tip could be seen clearly.
entries.zh: 插画师放大了那个钩样突起，使其弯曲尖端清楚可见。

entries.en: The collector photographed the annabergite before returning the mineral specimen to its padded box.
entries.zh: 收藏者先拍下镍华，再把矿物标本放回有软垫的盒子里。
